QuestInfo.name: [Cygnus Knights] Friendship is Impossible
QuestInfo.0: The townspeople are obviously on to you now, and they're keeping eyes on you everywhere you go. That doctor seems like she might have something to say, though...
QuestInfo.1: The doctor knows your identity. She suggests you talk somewhere private...
QuestInfo.2: The doctor says you can run your investigation, but without any help from the citizens. She also says that the Knights and the Resistance will never be on speaking terms again.
